paths: an unknown answer stays unselected; neither a preview attempt nor a required-checkbox change silently declares the first option
an explicitly selected draft survives preview cancellation and becomes a declaration only after separate apply
clearing an answer and reaching an explicit expiry both return the editor to an unselected state without reviving the old value
tab navigation and an unchanged refresh preserve the unsent schedule and its automatic end-time mode without creating an appointment
a manually edited ending stays manual across navigation and refresh; explicitly choosing a new duration restores automatic end calculation
pausing and resuming does not resurrect a previously unsent schedule draft
successful proposal clears the sent draft; after the counterpart marks only the time as unsuitable, an ordinary new proposal starts blank
explicit reuse copies only the previous place and duration; turning storage consent off and on discards that seed instead of reviving it on returning to the inbox
a new proposal version written through another role-authenticated tab discards the older local edit and shows the current server proposal
navigating the real demo-role link in the same tab never transfers an unsent draft to another actor or restores it after returning
a counterpart public withdrawal removes the draft and closes the connection; restoring public visibility alone does not revive the old draft or acceptance
